attempt_history.llm_sketch:
The workflow validates successfully. Here is the final YAML:

workflow_id: wf_aw_007
steps:
  - id: receive_query
    op: extract_field
    params:
      source: request.body
      field: query
    output: sed_query

  - id: authenticate
    op: authenticate_user
    params:
      token: request.headers.authorization
    output: auth_context

  - id: generate_embedding
    op: fetch_api
    params:
      method: POST
      url: /api/embeddings
      body:
        text: "{{sed_query}}"
    output: query_embedding

  - id: search_seds
    op: read_database
    params:
      table: seds
      match_column: embedding
      match_value: "{{query_embedding.vector}}"
      method: vector_similarity
      limit: 20
    output: matching_seds

  - id: stream_per_sed_summaries
    op: loop_records
    params:
      collection: "{{matching_seds}}"
      steps:
        - id: build_sed_summary
          op: transform_json
          params:
            template:
              type: sed_result
              sed_id: "{{item.id}}"
              title: "{{item.title}}"
              summary: "{{item.summary}}"
              score: "{{item.similarity_score}}"
          output: sed_chunk
        - id: stream_sed_chunk
          op: format_output
          params:
            format: ndjson
            stream: true
            data: "{{sed_chunk}}"

  - id: generate_synthesis
    op: fetch_api
    params:
      method: POST
      url: /api/llm/synthesize
      body:
        query: "{{sed_query}}"
        results: "{{matching_seds}}"
      stream: true
    output: synthesis_result

  - id: stream_synthesis
    op: format_output
    params:
      format: ndjson
      stream: true
      data:
        type: synthesis
        content: "{{synthesis_result.text}}"

  - id: log_search
    op: log_audit
    params:
      action: sed_search
      user: "{{auth_context.user_id}}"
      query: "{{sed_query}}"
      result_count: "{{matching_seds.length}}"
      timestamp: "{{now}}"
